verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains only developer/API documentation (bots, webhooks, OAuth2, Social SDK for games) and community commentary on unrelated topics like verification and moderation; none of it documents the core client feature of a user/admin starting a voice or video call directly from a text channel or DM inside the Discord app itself. Mentions of 'voice chat' (discord-docs-3, discord-docs-41) refer to the Social SDK for third-party games, not native in-app calling.
